g.text: Objective: follow one fact of one ticker's company facts into the annual or quarterly row it belongs to, or out of the import.
back to the refresh board

text.tspan: one fact of the ticker is read
duration facts take their own start and end; the filing's fy and fp never pick the period
the fact belongs to a year or quarter row
concept precedence per column and period end: the first concept in the list with an accepted fact wins
later concepts fill only empty ends
e.g. revenue: Revenues, then RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, ...
is_restated when a fact used for the period comes from an amendment
the fact fills its column for that period end
one value per column and period end
the aggregates of the row are derived
only when not reported, and a reported aggregate is never overwritten
earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) = earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) + depreciation
EBIT, when not reported = pretax income + interest expense
free cash flow = operating cash flow − capex
working capital = current assets − current liabilities
the row has its fiscal year
an annual row takes the year of its end; a quarter gets its year and number from the nearest year end
the row of the fact is ready to write
annual share counts are corrected
the fact is dropped
the import goes on without it

g.text: the company facts and submissions of the ticker are fetched from SEC EDGAR (the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval system)
the facts of the ticker are parsed into rows
financials_annual
financials_quarterly

text.tspan: Comes out:
annual rows, one per fiscal_year, to financials_annual
quarterly rows, one per (fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter), to financials_quarterly
share counts corrected
the facts of the ticker are read one by one
[the company facts arrive]

g.text: the fact counts for a year [a duration of 350 to 380 days from a 10-K or 10-K/A]
the fact counts for a quarter [a duration of 80 to 100 days from a 10-Q or 10-Q/A, in a column stored quarterly]
the fact joins the row ending on its date [an instant on a year or quarter end]
the fact is dropped [any other span, form or date]
its concept fills the column [the first concept in the list with a fact for that end]
the fact is not used [an earlier concept already fills that end]
earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), free cash flow and working capital are derived [when not reported and their inputs exist]

text.tspan: the row takes the calendar year of its end [a year row]
fiscal year = calendar year of its end
the quarter is numbered from the nearest year end [a year end within 380 days]
fiscal year = year of the next year end within 380 days; quarter = fourth quarter minus whole 91.3-day steps back from it (days ÷ 91.3, rounded)
else forward from the previous year end: fiscal year = its year + 1, quarter = whole 91.3-day steps since it
year end limit = top of the 350 to 380 day annual span

g.text: the quarter takes the label of the filing that first reported it [no year end near it, or a quarter number outside one to four]
the row is dropped [a quarter with no usable year end and no filing label]

text.tspan: the row is dropped [a later period end has the same label]
the later period end is kept
the diluted share count is multiplied by a million or a thousand [a whole scale off the median of three or more other counts]
ratio = median of the other positive annual counts ÷ count
factors 1,000,000 then 1,000; kept when factor ÷ 2 ≤ ratio ≤ factor × 2
needs ≥ 3 other counts

g.text: the share count is kept [in scale with three or more other counts]
the share count is kept [fewer than three other counts]
the quarter row is kept as is [a quarter row]
parsing goes on with the row
parsing goes on without the fact

text.tspan: annual row, one per fiscal_year
written by refresh-fundamentals in its one transaction
quarterly row, one per (fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter)
written by refresh-fundamentals in its one transaction

g.text: the rows of the ticker
